answer: Commit-Reveal Ledger Ledge: each new identity must publish a hash commitment before receiving a one-time action quota; the reveal must match a prior on-chain ledge entry, so clones cannot batch-register without pre-committing capital. Unmatched reveals forfeit a fixed deposit sized above expected clone yield, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV. The trellis of reveals also ties quotas to a rolling window, and audits sample reveals against basalt-anchored timestamps to block replayed commitments.
